# oneworld Global Explorer Planner

> An unofficial, browser-based planner for building and validating oneworld Global Explorer round-the-world itineraries.

## Purpose

Use this application to construct a flight-by-flight itinerary, estimate mileage, and check the route-derived Global Explorer rules implemented by the planner.

## Recommended workflow

1. Open the browser planner at `/`.
2. Select the cabin class and mileage band.
3. Add flights in travel order.
4. Mark each intermediate arrival as a transfer or stopover.
5. Review route validation after every change.
6. Continue until the status is Valid, or report unresolved violations, incomplete requirements, warnings, and limitations to the user.
7. Use Share to create a read-only link. A recipient must explicitly choose Copy and edit before the shared plan replaces their local itinerary.

## Machine-readable resources

- Capabilities: `/capabilities.json`
- Itinerary and route-data schema: `/schema.json`
- Airport and eligible route snapshot: `/route-data.json`
- Browser planner: `/`

## Important behavior

- Routes in `/route-data.json` are directional.
- Only direct routes attributed to eligible Global Explorer carriers are included.
- A missing route may reflect incomplete or outdated source data and does not prove that a flight does not operate.
- Open jaws are derived when consecutive flights use different airports. A closing origin-to-destination open jaw can also be enabled in the planner.
- Itinerary mileage is estimated from airport coordinates. Route-snapshot distance and duration fields are planning data, not fare-construction guarantees.
- Valid means the route passes the checks implemented by this planner.
- Valid does not confirm schedules, inventory, fares, booking-class availability, minimum connection times, ticketing agreements, pricing, or ticket issuance.

## Privacy and persistence

The planner stores the current itinerary in browser-local storage. Itinerary data is not uploaded by the application. Share snapshots are compressed into the URL fragment and can be read by anyone who has the link. Opening a share is read-only and does not replace local data. Clearing browser data can remove the saved itinerary.

## Official terms

- Global Explorer Rule 9701 dated 27 February 2026: https://assets.ctfassets.net/m9ph4qvas97u/2pqmhTK95sqIsn5UP02lz/a55a65324e4eff966e9d520216b6c307/Global_Explorer_27_FEB_26.pdf
